ranch: Baadlands Farms — Pueblo, Colorado (120-Mile Southern CO Radius)
compliance_note: All intact breeding and show goats leave the ranch with an official USDA Scrapie Flock ID ear tag (9 CFR Part 79) and Colorado Bill of Sale. Exempt from in-state Colorado brand inspection under CRS § 35-53-101.
